name: Witch Doctor: Arcane Brew (#3220)
contract: Arcane Brew 801689 (SpellFamilyName 19, Witch Doctor) is a two-effect ally buff. Effect 0 applies SPELL_AURA_ASCENSION_MOD_SPELL_POWER_FLAT (345, EffectMiscValue 127 = every school) which Unit::SpellBaseDamageBonusDone consumes through GetTotalAuraModifier at Unit.cpp:9571 (AuraEffect::HandleModHealingDone at SpellAuraEffects.cpp:4496 only refreshes the client display; the real contribution is the GetTotalAuraModifier term, which runs for any unit). Effect 1 applies stock SPELL_AURA_MOD_STAT (29) with EffectMiscValue 4 = STAT_SPIRIT, a native 3.3.5 handler. Both effects share EffectBasePoints 29, EffectDieSides 1, EffectRealPointsPerLevel 1.5, BaseLevel/SpellLevel 31; SpellEffectInfo::CalcValue (SpellInfo.cpp:468-505) resolves this to 30 at level 31 and 103 at level 80 (29 + int32((80-31)*1.5=73.5 truncated to 73) + 1 from DieSides==1). DurationIndex 1 = SpellDuration.dbc 10000 ms; RecoveryTime 120000 ms. Every clause the tooltip promises (ally target, 40 yd range, instant cast, 2 min cooldown, 10 sec duration, +spell power, +Spirit, level scaling) is delivered by generic engine paths; nothing Witch-Doctor-specific needs to run. Regression scenario for behaviour that already works natively (#3220), not a handler fix.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
Group wd and ally so TARGET_UNIT_TARGET_ALLY resolves
Effect 0's level-80 value resolves to the DBC-derived 103 (29 base + 73 from 1.5/level over 49 levels + 1 from DieSides)
Effect 1 resolves to the same 103, sharing base points/scaling with effect 0
Baseline shadow spell power on an unbuffed control
Baseline Spirit on an unbuffed control
Arcane Brew's own aura lands on the ally
Duration is the DBC's 10 seconds (SpellDuration.dbc id 1)
Aura 345 actually raises the ally's shadow spell power by 103 over the unbuffed control (proves GetTotalAuraModifier consumes it, not just the display refresh)
Aura 29 (SPELL_AURA_MOD_STAT) raises the ally's Spirit by 103 over the unbuffed control
Arcane Brew goes on its DBC's 2 minute cooldown
